_what: An extension reading process.env or importing an authority-bearing node:* module. Counts may shrink, never grow.
_why_it_has_a_gate: An in-process extension reading process.env sees the ENGINE's whole environment - DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY - which is both far more than it needs and a way around the capability gate on ctx.internals.
_this_baseline_is_a_debt: These 24 sites were invisible until 2026-08-18: the gate walked a fixed <category>/<name>/engine path and 12 of the 57 extensions live at another depth (6 at the top level, 5 under compliance/ro). It reported 'with no exceptions' about the 45 it could see. Four of the twelve read process.env all along.
_why_not_fixed_here: ExtensionConfig is a curated interface, not an env passthrough, so moving OPENAI_API_KEY or STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET onto it would put Stripe and OpenAI specifics into the engine - the opposite of the single-source-of-truth rule. The established alternative is the extension's own zv_settings row (see communications/mail), but switching to it changes how every EXISTING install configures these four extensions. That is an owner decision, not a refactor.
